extracted.name: Homemade Biscuit Mix
extracted.description: Keep this basic biscuit mix on hand and you'll be able to make quick, tasty homemade biscuits in minutes—or use this in any recipe that calls for biscuit mix.
instruction_lines: Combine flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl. Add oil and mix with a fork or pastry blender; you should have small lumps throughout the mixture.
Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place for up to three months.
